description.describe_ch: 本課程提供研究生未來欲從事聲學相關研究主題之基本素養、知識及工具，並了解該領域的最新課題與應用。教授主題如下：1)聲波方程，2)平面波、球面波和柱面波，3)聲波的反射、折射與透射，4)典型聲源及其聲輻射，5)脈動球源、點聲源和多極子聲源，6)無限障板上活塞式輻射聲場，7) 陣列，8)聲波在管中、音箱的傳播與聲波導管理論，9) 聲波的接收與散射，10) 聲波的吸收。
description.describe_eh: This course is aimed to perpetuate students and build a strong foundation on acoustics with technical literacy and knowledge. Students who have further interests in studying related fields, applications, and contemporary topics should find this course helpful. The subjects in this course include: 1) useful math techniques for acoustics, 2) simple and coupled harmonic oscillators, 3) vibration of strings, bars, and membranes, 4) the acoustic wave equation, 5) plane sound waves and waves in cylindrical and spherical coordinates, 6) reflection, refraction, and transmission, 7) radiation of a baffled piston, 8) monopoles, dipoles, and arrayed sound sources, and 9) sound waves in 3-dim enclosures and wave guides.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解聲學波動方程式及其解法，平面波，球面波和柱面波之性質。
targets.describe_en: Realizing the wave equation and corresponding resolution, and the properties of plane wave, spherical wave, and cylindrical wave.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解平面波反射，透射（折射）制定律和隔聲原理。
targets.describe_en: Realizing the theorem of the reflection, transmission, and isolation of the plane wave.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解典型的聲源形態及其聲輻射：脈動球源、點聲源和多極子聲源，無線障板上活塞式輻射聲場。
targets.describe_en: Realizing the classical sound source and corresponding acoustic radiation: Impulse sound source, point sound source, multi-pole sound, and the piston sound field with the infinite baffled plate.

targets.describe_ch: 應用於電聲、噪聲、超聲等工程領域之相關分析問題。
targets.describe_en: Applied the theorems and methods to the problems in the electroacoustic, noise, and ultrasonic fields.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Useful mathematics: 
  • Taylor series.
  • Integration by parts.
  • Logarithmic differentiation.
  • Equilibrium, stability, and Hooke's law.
  • Potentials and forces.
  • A simple pendulum.
  • The concept of linearity.
  • Superpositions and Fourier synthesis.
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en:
Students self introduction.
Course introduction, in-class activities, and syllabus
Grading and office hours
Resources, in-class demonstrations, and software tools for analysis and visualization.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Useful mathematics continued:
  • The complex plant and phasor notation.
  • Time averages of complex products, e.g. power.
  • Standard units and dimensional homogeneity.
  • Random errors (noise) and relative uncertainty.
  • Normal error function or the Gaussian distribution.
  • Systematic errors (bias).
  • Error propagation and covariance.
  • Significant figures.
  • Least-squares fitting and parameter estimation.
  • Linear Correlation Coefficient.
  • Linearized Least-Squares Fitting.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂規則，習慣班級文化。 
一、課堂禮儀
1.	多元化和包容性
課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。
2.	課堂行為
(1)	學生應準時出席上課；如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。
(2)	上課時請勿講話、閱讀其他刊物、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除積極參與分組討論外，應減少與旁邊同學對話。
(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Classroom behavior should always be timely, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Mutual dignity and respect between students and teachers are essential for effective learning. To ensure a positive learning environment, it is hoped that everyone can follow the points below, abide by classroom rules, and adapt to the class culture.

I. Classroom Etiquette
Diversity and Inclusion
Class activities should be conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere among students. Everyone should respect and appreciate each student's personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, such as different educational systems domestically and internationally, diverse admissions and learning cultures, racial cultures, socio-economic backgrounds, and gender.

Classroom Behavior
(1) Students should attend class on time; if you cannot attend class punctually, please do not enroll in the course.
(2) During class, do not talk, read unrelated materials, sleep, or engage in tasks unrelated to the course. Except for actively participating in group discussions, conversations with nearby classmates should be minimized.
(3) When classmates are presenting or asking questions, you should listen attentively.

II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette
iLearn as a Classroom
iLearn is still considered a classroom, and appropriate classroom behavior must be maintained to respect classmates and teachers.

Participation in Online Learning
You should allocate time to actively participate in iLearn's online learning activities and complete all assigned tasks to fulfill course activities.

Online Discussion Etiquette
(1) Do not dominate any discussion; give others a chance to participate and enhance everyone's learning experience.
(2) Maintain an open mind, respect minority opinions, and feel free to express differing views.
(3) Write focused and concise responses that stay on topic.
(4) Read all posts or comments before writing your own to avoid redundant comments or asking already answered questions.
(5) Review and proofread your comments before submitting them.
(6) Be mindful of online communication language; avoid excessive use of emoticons.
(7) Avoid using regional dialects or slang, as they may lead to misunderstandings.
(8) Share helpful tips with others and refrain from mocking someone’s literacy skills.
(9) Consider others' privacy. Always ask for permission before sharing a classmate's email address or other personal information.
(10) Do not post inappropriate messages or forward virus warnings, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or teachers.

III. Student Responsibilities
Updating Personal Information
Before the start of each semester, every student should log into their MyFCU profile and confirm their personal information at Feng Chia University, including their mobile phone number, mailing address, and other contact details. This ensures that the course instructor, teaching assistants, or administrative staff can contact you.
(1) Make sure your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID are activated, as o365 is the common tool for communication between teachers and students.
(2) When communicating with teachers and classmates via email or bulletin boards, provide clear and polite information.
(3) Your emails should be signed; teachers will not respond to anonymous messages.

Understanding the Course Syllabus
You should thoroughly read and understand the course syllabus requirements, stay updated with the latest information, and manage your study time effectively.

Checking University Email Regularly
Regularly check your Feng-Chia University email and log into iLearn to stay informed about course announcements.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
綜合說明
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。 
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。
  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。
3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。
  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。
以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分。

Classroom behavior should always be timely, professional, well-prepared, and polite. Mutual respect and dignity between students and teachers are essential for effective learning. To ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to follow these guidelines, adhere to classroom rules, and embrace the class culture.
I. Classroom Etiquette
  1. Diversity and Inclusion
    Class activities should be conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere among students. Each person’s personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives—such as different education systems, various enrollment and learning cultures, racial and socio-economic backgrounds, and gender—should be respected and appreciated.
  2. Classroom Behavior
    (1) Students should attend class on time; if you cannot attend regularly, please do not enroll in the course.
    (2) Do not talk, read unrelated materials, sleep, or engage in non-course-related tasks during class. Apart from actively participating in group discussions, minimize conversations with neighboring classmates.
    (3) When classmates are presenting or asking questions, you should listen attentively.
II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette
  1. iLearn as a Classroom
    iLearn remains an extension of the classroom, and appropriate classroom behavior must be maintained to respect classmates and teachers.
  2. Participation in Online Activities
    You should allocate time to actively participate in iLearn online learning activities and complete all assigned tasks to fulfill the course requirements.
  3. Online Discussion Etiquette
    (1) Do not dominate any discussion; give others a chance to participate and enhance everyone’s learning experience.
    (2) Keep an open mind, respect minority opinions, and feel free to express differing views.
    (3) Present your ideas appropriately and avoid using offensive or vulgar language.
    (4) Stay on topic and be concise in your writing.
    (5) Before commenting, read all previous posts to avoid redundant comments or asking already answered questions.
    (6) Review and proofread your comments before posting.
    (7) Be mindful of online communication language; avoid excessive use of emoticons.
    (8) Avoid using regional dialects or slang that might cause misunderstandings.
    (9) Do not ridicule anyone's literacy skills; offer helpful tips instead.
    (10) Respect others' privacy. Seek permission before sharing a classmate’s email address or other personal information.
    (11) Do not post inappropriate messages or forward virus warnings, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or teachers.
III. Student Responsibilities
  1. Update Personal Information
    Before the start of each semester, students should log into their MyFCU profile to confirm their personal information at Feng Chia University, including mobile phone number, mailing address, and other contact details. This ensures that the course instructor, teaching assistants, or administrative staff can reach you.
    (1) Ensure that your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID are activated, as o365 is the standard tool for communication between teachers and students.
    (2) When communicating via email or bulletin boards with teachers and classmates, provide clear and polite information.
    (3) Sign your emails; teachers will not respond to anonymous messages.
  2. Understand the Course Syllabus
    Read and understand the course syllabus requirements thoroughly and stay updated with the latest information to manage your study time effectively.
  3. Check Your University Email Regularly
    Regularly check your Feng Chia University email and log into iLearn to stay informed about course-related announcements.
  4. Provide Feedback on Course Instruction
    Based on the instructor’s teaching content and methods, complete mid-term and final course feedback forms. Your participation and feedback will help improve the instructor’s teaching skills, course content, and the arrangement of learning activities.
    (1) The mid-term formative teaching evaluation form should be completed between weeks 4 to 8.
    (2) The end-of-term student opinion survey and final course objectives achievement assessment should be completed during the last month of the semester.

integrity.course_pol_en:
Classroom behavior should always be timely, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Mutual dignity and respect between students and teachers are essential for effective learning. To ensure a positive learning environment, it is hoped that everyone can follow the points below, abide by classroom rules, and adapt to the class culture.

I. Classroom Etiquette
Diversity and Inclusion
Class activities should be conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere among students. Everyone should respect and appreciate each student's personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, such as different educational systems domestically and internationally, diverse admissions and learning cultures, racial cultures, socio-economic backgrounds, and gender.

Classroom Behavior
(1) Students should attend class on time; if you cannot attend class punctually, please do not enroll in the course.
(2) During class, do not talk, read unrelated materials, sleep, or engage in tasks unrelated to the course. Except for actively participating in group discussions, conversations with nearby classmates should be minimized.
(3) When classmates are presenting or asking questions, you should listen attentively.

II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette
iLearn as a Classroom
iLearn is still considered a classroom, and appropriate classroom behavior must be maintained to respect classmates and teachers.

Participation in Online Learning
You should allocate time to actively participate in iLearn's online learning activities and complete all assigned tasks to fulfill course activities.

Online Discussion Etiquette
(1) Do not dominate any discussion; give others a chance to participate and enhance everyone's learning experience.
(2) Maintain an open mind, respect minority opinions, and feel free to express differing views.
(3) Write focused and concise responses that stay on topic.
(4) Read all posts or comments before writing your own to avoid redundant comments or asking already answered questions.
(5) Review and proofread your comments before submitting them.
(6) Be mindful of online communication language; avoid excessive use of emoticons.
(7) Avoid using regional dialects or slang, as they may lead to misunderstandings.
(8) Share helpful tips with others and refrain from mocking someone’s literacy skills.
(9) Consider others' privacy. Always ask for permission before sharing a classmate's email address or other personal information.
(10) Do not post inappropriate messages or forward virus warnings, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or teachers.

III. Student Responsibilities
Updating Personal Information
Before the start of each semester, every student should log into their MyFCU profile and confirm their personal information at Feng Chia University, including their mobile phone number, mailing address, and other contact details. This ensures that the course instructor, teaching assistants, or administrative staff can contact you.
(1) Make sure your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID are activated, as o365 is the common tool for communication between teachers and students.
(2) When communicating with teachers and classmates via email or bulletin boards, provide clear and polite information.
(3) Your emails should be signed; teachers will not respond to anonymous messages.

Understanding the Course Syllabus
You should thoroughly read and understand the course syllabus requirements, stay updated with the latest information, and manage your study time effectively.

Checking University Email Regularly
Regularly check your Feng-Chia University email and log into iLearn to stay informed about course announcements.
integrity.ais_meno:
綜合說明
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。 
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。
  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。

  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。

policy.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂規則，習慣班級文化。 
一、課堂禮儀
1.	多元化和包容性
課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。
2.	課堂行為
(1)	學生應準時出席上課；如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。
(2)	上課時請勿講話、閱讀其他刊物、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除積極參與分組討論外，應減少與旁邊同學對話。
(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。

courseBankC.describe_ch: 瞭解聲學波動方程式及其解法，平面波，球面波和柱面波之性質。
courseBankC.describe_en: Realizing the wave equation and corresponding resolution, and the properties of plane wave, spherical wave, and cylindrical wave.
courseBankC.core_item: 應用基礎科學以系統化思維發掘、研判、診斷電聲工程問題，並可得出解決方案之能力與永續發展。
courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to apply fundamental scientific knowledge and systematic thinking to explore, analyze, and diagnose electro-acoustic engineering problems and develop sustainable solutions.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 瞭解平面波反射，透射（折射）制定律和隔聲原理。
courseBankC.describe_en: Realizing the theorem of the reflection, transmission, and isolation of the plane wave.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備應用數學模式來描述、分析電聲工程相關問題，並有規劃與執行專題研究，以解決複雜且整合性工程問題之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Proficiency in applying mathematical models to describe and analyze electro-acoustic engineering problems and planning and executing research projects to solve complex, integrated engineering problems.
evalb_name: 學習歷程檔案「個人/小組」紀錄
專題/成果發表(專家審查)

courseBankC.describe_ch: 瞭解典型的聲源形態及其聲輻射：脈動球源、點聲源和多極子聲源，無線障板上活塞式輻射聲場。
courseBankC.describe_en: Realizing the classical sound source and corresponding acoustic radiation: Impulse sound source, point sound source, multi-pole sound, and the piston sound field with the infinite baffled plate.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備整合電聲工程領域相關知識進行分析、設計及獨立解決問題之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to integrate relevant knowledge in electro-acoustic engineering for analysis, design, and independent problem-solving.
evalb_name: 學生歷年學習性質成果紀錄
專題/成果發表(專家審查)

courseBankC.describe_ch: 應用於電聲、噪聲、超聲等工程領域之相關分析問題。
courseBankC.describe_en: Applied the theorems and methods to the problems in the electroacoustic, noise, and ultrasonic fields.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備掌握國際電聲發展趨勢及對於環境永 續、社會共好及全球發展的影響，培養技術接軌之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to understand global trends in electro-acoustic development and cultivate technological convergence while considering the impact of environmental sustainability, social well-being, and international development.
